summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The ProShares S&P Kensho Smart Factories ETF (MAKX) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Kensho Smart Factories index. The fund tracks a modified equal-weighted index of US-listed firms that enable the digitalization of manufacturing. MAKX was launched on Sep 29, 2021 and is issued by ProShares.

holdings.infoBox: MAKX is an equity ETF with a total of 25 individual holdings. The top holdings are Ouster stock at 8.85%, 3D Systems at 7.37%, Cognex at 6.18%, Emerson Electric Co. at 6.05%, and Autodesk at 5.69%.
